entries.title: Entry — the ledger opens
entries.body: The collection's private ledger starts here. Everything the public site summarizes, this feed details: numbers, decisions, mistakes, next moves.

entries.title: Headquarters — renovation in progress
entries.body: The 1,674 m² property is being converted into offices: the production base for every venture. Target: operational before the shipchandling mission ends in June.

entries.title: Online hypermarket — catalogue build
entries.body: 18,000 supplier-backed references being wired to live stock. Beta opens to holders first.

entries.title: Team — first seats
entries.body: M&A specialist onboarding; marketing specialist identified. More seats open as ventures launch.

dealroom.title: M&A brand — negotiation open
dealroom.body: In talks to acquire the brand of an established mergers & acquisitions firm. It becomes the buy-side machine for land, premises, companies and tourism assets. Status: terms being discussed.

dealroom.title: Watchlist — distressed assets
dealroom.body: Mapping owners looking for a way out after the downturn: commercial premises and seafront positions first. Detailed memos will land here before anything is public.
